answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments provide a cryptographic signal of provenance, while sequential verifiable delay primitives prevent rapid agent replication through inescapable temporal latencies. By mandating high staking collateral and severe slashing penalties, the protocol ensures the nadir of expected utility remains strictly negative for any adversary attempting credential forgery. This mechanism establishes a robust Nash equilibrium at the summit of security, making coordinated Sybil attacks computationally infeasible.
